hooks.command: Write-Output '## Documentación del proyecto'; Get-Content funcionalidades.md, Lista_test.md, plan-ejecucion.md, planning.md, vps_deploy_guide.md, vps_plan.md -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$changed = @(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>$null) + @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>$null) | Select-Object -Unique; $webFiles = $changed | Where-Object { $_ -match '^recaudify-web/.*\.(ts|html|scss|css)$' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '^recaudify-web/', '' }; if ($webFiles.Count -gt 0) { pnpm --prefix recaudify-web exec prettier --write @($webFiles) --ignore-unknown 2>$null }; exit 0

$excluded = @('planning.md','CLAUDE.md','AGENTS.md','Pendientes mios.md'); $changed = @(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>$null) + @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>$null) | Select-Object -Unique; $codeChanged = $changed | Where-Object { $excluded -notcontains $_ -and $_ -notmatch '^\.claude/' }; $planChanged = $changed -contains 'planning.md'; if ($codeChanged.Count -gt 0 -and -not $planChanged) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Hay cambios de codigo sin reflejar en planning.md. Ejecuta /update-plan antes de terminar.'); exit 2 }; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Verificando si planning.md está al día...

hooks.command: $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($file -match '\.env(\.|$)' -or $file -match '\.(pem|key)$' -or $file -match 'id_rsa') { $reason = 'ADVERTENCIA DE AJUSTE: ARCHIVO SENSIBLE (credenciales/claves). Confirma que realmente quieres modificarlo.'; $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'ask'; permissionDecisionReason = $reason } }; $out | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }; exit 0

$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = $json.tool_input.file_path; if (-not $file) { exit 0 }; if ($file -match '\.php$') { php recaudify-api/vendor/bin/pint "$file" 2>$null } elseif ($file -match '\.(ts|html|scss|css)$') { pnpm --prefix recaudify-web exec prettier --write "$file" --ignore-unknown 2>$null }; exit 0
